999008199.text:
「飴」の所持者の位置を把握できる装置、
ついに完成よ！

localizations.en: The device that lets us track the location of everyone with a candy—we finally finished it!

999008199.text:
そしてなんと……支援物資を届ける機能も
ついでに作ることができたわ

localizations.en: And what's more... we were also able to add a feature that lets us deliver support items!

999008199.text:
これで、遠く離れた仲間にも必要なものを
すぐに届けられますね。旅がずっと安心になります

localizations.en: Now we can get what we need to our friends no matter how far away they are. It'll make traveling so much safer.

999008199.text:
スールたちが作っていた「イタズラ装置」を
応用したのが功を奏しました

localizations.en: Adapting the 'Prank Device' that Suelle and the others created turned out to be quite effective.

999008199.text:
亜空の道を通じて、
「飴」を持つ者の元へ物資を転送できます

localizations.en: By utilizing the Dimensional Paths, we can transfer supplies directly to anyone who possesses a candy.

999008199.text:
ただ、送ることができるのはあくまで「物」のみで、
亜空の道を利用した人の移動は実現できませんでした

localizations.en: However, we can only send objects through it. Using the Dimensional Paths to transport people proved impossible.

999008199.text:
それだけ、ハルフェンに居たというクルシュアは
特別な力を持っていたということだな

localizations.en: That just goes to show how much special power Kerscha—who was in Hallfein—truly possessed.

999008199.text: しかし、まさかイタズラが役に立つとはな……

localizations.en: Still, who would've thought a prank device would actually come in handy...?

999008199.text:
……奇跡みたいな偶然ね。
まあ、実用性は高いし、悪くない

localizations.en: ...It's almost like a miracle. Well, it's highly practical, so I suppose it's not bad.

999008199.text:
ただし！　絶対にイタズラには使わないこと！
分かったわね、スール！

localizations.en: But! You must never use this for pranks! Do you understand me, Suelle?!

999008199.text:
ご、ごめんなさい……
もうイタズラには使いません……

localizations.en: I-I'm sorry... I won't use it for pranks anymore...

999008199.text: ほんとに反省してるから、許して……

localizations.en: We really are reflecting on it, so please forgive us...

999008199.text: まったく……今度やったら、アトリエ出禁よ

localizations.en: Good grief... If you do it again, you'll be banned from the atelier.

999008199.text: なんか、便利なものができたらしいな

localizations.en: Sounds like they made something pretty useful.

999008199.text:
……なあ、レント。どうせなら、アトリエから
強力な攻撃も届けられたらいいのにって思わないか？

localizations.en: ...Hey, Lent. Don't you think it'd be cool if we could send powerful attacks from the atelier too?

999008199.text:
確かにな。デッカイ大砲作ってさ、
どこにいてもドカーンと一発撃てたら最高だよな

localizations.en: For sure. We could build a huge cannon and fire off massive shots no matter where we are!

999008199.text:
砲弾はマリーに頼めば、
きっととんでもないのを作ってくれるぜ

localizations.en: If we ask Marie to handle the ammunition, I bet she'd whip up something incredible.

999008199.text:
あんたたち、物騒なこと考えてるわね……
そんな大砲ができるなら、もちろん協力するけど

localizations.en: You guys are thinking some pretty violent thoughts... But if we could actually build a cannon like that, I'd definitely help out.

999008199.text: やっぱ無理かあ？

いいや！　夢は終わらねえ。
いつか必ず実現してやるさ！

localizations.en: No way! The dream lives on. I'll make it happen someday, you'll see!

999008199.text: そうだな……男の浪漫ってやつだ！

なんか燃えてる……そのうちアトリエに
巨大な大砲が建ってたりして

localizations.en: They're really getting fired up... Next thing you know, there'll be a giant cannon sticking out of the atelier.

999008199.text: ……まさかね？
